Cinépolis at Oman Avenues Mall offers a decent movie experience, but there are areas that need improvement. Parking on the rooftop is the best option since it provides direct access to the cinema, which is quite convenient.

However, I found the display quality disappointing—it leans towards the darker side, making it difficult to fully enjoy the visual effects. The sound system is average and doesn’t provide the immersive experience expected from a premium theater.

I watched Empuraan (Malayalam movie) on Screen 6, and the experience was just okay. Food items and bags are not allowed inside, which can be inconvenient.

The deluxe seating is quite hard, lacking proper cushioning, making it uncomfortable for longer movies. The temperature is set to a normal level, which might be a plus for some, but I personally expected a more chilled environment.

The food section has multiple counters, but during the interval, long queues form, and staff seem insufficient to handle the rush. That said, the staff is very attentive and professional, ensuring smooth service despite the crowd.

Overall, Cinépolis Oman Avenues Mall is average—convenient parking and good staff, but the display, sound quality, and seating comfort could be significantly improved. Would consider visiting again if these issues are addressed.

సోహార్‌లోని ఓయాసిస్ మాల్‌లో ఉన్న సినీ పోలీస్ మూవీ థియేటర్‌ను సందర్శించిన అనుభవం నిజంగా అద్భుతమైనది. ఈ థియేటర్‌లో సినిమా చూసే ప్రతి క్షణం అసాధారణమైన అనుభూతిని అందిస్తుంది. థియేటర్‌లోని సౌండ్ సిస్టమ్ అత్యుత్తమ నాణ్యతతో, సినిమా అనుభవాన్ని మరింత ఆకర్షణీయంగా మార్చింది. స్క్రీన్‌ల నాణ్యత, శుభ్రత, మరియు వాతావరణం అన్నీ అత్యంత ఆకర్షణీయంగా ఉన్నాయి.

Visiting the Cinepolis Movie Theatre at Oasis Mall in Sohar was an absolutely delightful experience. The theatre offers a remarkable cinematic experience, with top-notch sound quality and screen visuals that elevate the movie-watching experience to another level. The cleanliness, ambiance, and overall environment are impeccable, creating a welcoming and comfortable atmosphere for visitors.

A standout feature is the exceptional behavior of the staff, who are highly cooperative, friendly, and professional, ensuring a seamless experience. The self-service touch screen monitors for ticket booking are a convenient addition, making the process quick and efficient. With a total of eight screens, the theatre showcases a diverse range of films, including Indian regional language movies and Hollywood blockbusters, catering to a wide audience.
